name: move_vault_folder
description: Renames or moves a vault folder, with everything inside it, from path to toPath. The folder above toPath must already exist, and nothing may be at toPath; the move never replaces anything. Move files with move_vault_file.

surfaceId.description: The vault Surface's ID, from list_surfaces. Must satisfy the required format.

path.description: The folder to move. Must satisfy the required format.

toPath.description: Its new path, including its name. Must satisfy the required format.
